input.question: When did the Women's Strike take place?

documents.text: disambiguation ) . 1975 Icelandic women 's strike Women 's Day Off Date 24 October 1975 Location Iceland Caused by Gender pay gap , occupational sexism Goals To `` demonstrate the indispensable work of women for Iceland 's economy and society '' and `` protest wage discrepancy and unfair employment practices '' . Methods Women 's strike On 24 October 1975 , Icelandic women went on strike for the day to `` demonstrate the indispensable work of women for Iceland 's economy and society '' [ 1 ] and to `` protest wage discrepancy and unfair employment practices '' .
